pairs.text: a5er maw3ed la daf3 el 2eset el thani el sa3a 2 el dohor, wel fatoura msh tal3a 3indi 3ala efawateercom fa ma b2dar adfa3 abadan
pairs.translation: The last deadline to pay the second installment is at 2 PM, and the invoice didn't come up for me on efawateercom so I can't pay at all.

pairs.text: el da2ira el maliyeh msh m3tiyetni bara2et thimmeh lal ta5arroj 3ashan gharamet maktabeh 20 dinar dafa3tha aslan, w kashf el 5irrijin bisakker el sa3a 12
pairs.translation: The financial circle didn't give me the certificate for graduation because I owe the library 20 dinars that I originally paid, and the exit check closes at 12 o'clock.

pairs.text: ana taleb wafed w maw3ed tajdeed el e2ameh elyom el 3asr, w bdhom ktab bysabbet enni dafe3 el rusoom wel maliyeh lessa ma tala3to
pairs.translation: I am a visiting student and my residency renewal appointment is today in the afternoon, and I need a letter confirming that I have not yet paid the fees and financial dues.

pairs.text: 2addamt talab ta2jeel rusoom min asabee3 w ma 7ada radd 3alay, w elyom el nizam sa7abni min el fasel bsabab 3adam el daf3 w ra7o kol mawaddi
pairs.translation: I submitted a request to postpone the fees three weeks ago and no one responded to me, and today the system removed me from the class due to non-payment and all the materials are gone.

pairs.text: 2adesh aktar 3adad sa3at b2dar asajjlo bel fasel el 3adi? w b2dar azeed 3aleh eza m3addali 3ali?
pairs.translation: How many more hours can I register in the regular semester? And can I add more if my average is high?

pairs.text: shu 5atawat el ensi7ab min madeh wa7deh b nos el fasel? w btbayyen 3ala kashf el 3alamat?
pairs.translation: What are the consequences of withdrawing from one subject in the middle of the semester? And will it show on the grade report?

pairs.text: she3beh 2 min madet data structures malyaneh, fi 2a2emet entithar b2dar andam 3aleha? w kif btesht3'el?
pairs.translation: I have been studying data structures for 2 months, is there a waiting list I can join? And how does it work?

pairs.text: sar ma3i 95 sa3a, kif basajjel madet el tadreeb el maydani lal saifi? w lazem mowaf2et ra2ees el 2esem 2abel?
pairs.translation: I have 95 hours, how do I register the practical training course for the summer? And I need the approval of the department head first.

pairs.text: sajjalt she3bet el ethnein wel arba3a b madet el e7sa2, bas jadwali mbayyen enni b she3bet el a7ad wel thalatha
pairs.translation: I registered for the two and four sessions in the Statistics department, but my schedule shows that I am in the Sunday and Tuesday sessions.

pairs.text: madet mo5tabar el barmajeh tal3a marrtein 3ala jadwali, fa majmoo3 sa3ati tale3 21 badal 18
pairs.translation: The programming lab showed up twice on my schedule, so the total hours came out to 21 instead of 18.

pairs.text: el 3ameed wafa2 3ala talabi asajjel 21 sa3a, bas el nizam lessa mwa2afni 3end 18, wel sa7b wel edafeh bi5las el osbo3 el jay
pairs.translation: The dean approved my request to register for 21 hours, but the system is still holding me at 18, and the withdrawal and addition will finish next week.

pairs.text: 7alti bel nizam sarat faj2a 'monsa7eb min el fasel' ma3 enni ma talabt ansa7eb, w ma 3ad fi wala madeh btbayyen
pairs.translation: I got stuck in the system suddenly 'I am being removed from the class' even though I didn't ask to be removed, and there is no subject showing anymore.

pairs.text: el tasjeel el mt2a55er bisakker ba3d sa3a w 3indi 7ajez 'b7ajet mowaf2et el murshed', wel murshed taba3i b ejazeh, fa ma b2dar asajjel wala madeh
pairs.translation: The late registration will close after an hour and I have a reservation for 'the advisor's approval', and my advisor is on vacation, so I can't register or do anything.

pairs.text: el she3beh el wa7ideh la a5er madeh ejbariyeh dayletli enlaghat, w ana el mafrood at5arraj hal fasel. bedoonha ma ra7 at5arraj
pairs.translation: The only thing that is preventing me from graduating is the mandatory subject that I failed, and I am supposed to graduate this semester. Without it, I won't graduate.

pairs.text: bel 3'alat kabast ensi7ab 3ala madet el thermo badal el madeh el e5tiyariyeh, wel tasjeel 7akali btenraja3 bas la 7add el sa3a 3
pairs.translation: In the 3rd class, I suggest withdrawing from the thermo course instead of the elective course, and the registration will be reviewed but only until 3 o'clock.

pairs.text: kif bdeef email el jam3a 3ala tatbee2 outlook 3al mobile?
pairs.translation: How do I add the university email to the Outlook app on mobile?

pairs.text: el tolab byo5do microsoft office majanan? min wen banazzlo b 7esab el jam3a?
pairs.translation: Do students get Microsoft Office for free? Where do we download it with the university account?

pairs.text: kif b2dar afta7 2awa3ed bayanat el maktabeh min el beit? lazem VPN?
pairs.translation: How can I access the library's database from home? I need a VPN.

pairs.text: masa7t folder min el onedrive taba3 el jam3a bel 3'alat el osbo3 el madi, fi tari2a arja3o?
pairs.translation: I deleted a folder from the university's OneDrive last week, is there a way to recover it?

pairs.text: wala jehaz b mo5tabar el handaseh bi2bal 7esabi el jam3i, btetla3 eno malaf el mosta5dem ma byet7ammal. ba2i el tolab byfoto 3adi, w hassa basta5dem el laptop taba3i
pairs.translation: There is no device in the engineering lab before my university account, it turns out that the user's file cannot be handled. The rest of the students are taking it normally, and now I'm using my laptop.

pairs.text: email el jam3a ma wasalo wala resaleh min mbare7, b2dar a7ki el dakatra 3ala teams bas 5ayef yfoutni e3lanat
pairs.translation: I haven't received the university email or any messages since yesterday, I can talk to the doctor on Teams but I'm afraid I might miss announcements.

pairs.text: rmooz el ta7a22o2 la tasjeel el do5ool ma 3adat tewsal 3ala mobaili, sert ad5ol bel rmooz el e7tiyatiyeh bas dayel ma3i thnein
pairs.translation: The access codes for logging in are no longer being sent to my mobile, I started using the backup codes but I only have two left.

pairs.text: kol ma afta7 rabet el mu7adara el online min saf7et el madeh btetla3li 'access denied', sert afout min da3wet zamili
pairs.translation: Every time I open the link to the online lecture from the subject page, I get 'access denied', I started to enter through my colleague's invitation.

pairs.text: fi 7ada e5tara2 7esabi el jam3i w 3'ayyar el password w sar yeb3at spam lal daf3a kollha, w ana msakkar 3alay w tasleem el mashroo3 el sa3a 12 bel leil
pairs.translation: Someone hacked my university account and changed the password and is sending spam to the entire class, and I am locked out and the project submission is at 12 at night.

pairs.text: nizam el tasleem kol marra byerfod malaf mashroo3 el ta5arroj w btetla3 'server error', wel tasleem bisakker ba3d 40 d2i2a
pairs.translation: The submission system keeps rejecting the graduation project file and shows 'server error', and the submission closes after 40 minutes.

pairs.text: mo5tabar el 7asoob kollo fasal 3anno el net b nos emte7an el barmajeh el 3amali, thalatheen taleb wa2fin wel wa2t mashi
pairs.translation: The computer lab is completely disconnected from the internet during the practical programming exam, thirty students are waiting and time is passing.

pairs.text: muna2ashet el resaleh taba3ti online ballashat min 3ashar da2aye2 w manasset el video kol shway bet6alle3ni, wel lajneh mestanyeh
pairs.translation: My online presentation of my project started 10 minutes ago and the video platform keeps kicking me out, and the committee is waiting.

pairs.text: kif bashtrek b bas el jam3a lal fasel el jay? w 2adesh se3r eshterak el fasel?
pairs.translation: How do I register for the next semester at the university? And how much is the semester registration fee?

pairs.text: fi bas lal jam3a min el zar2a la 7aram el mushaqqar?
pairs.translation: There is just for the university from Al Zarqa to the cursed Mushaqqar.

pairs.text: wen bel zabt maw2af el bas b sweileh? awwal marra ra7 arkab el bas bukra
pairs.translation: Where exactly is the bus stop in Sweileh? It's my first time taking the bus tomorrow.

pairs.text: nseet jaketti b bas el jam3a mbare7, ma3 meen ba7ki 3ashan arja3ha?
pairs.translation: I forgot my jacket at the university yesterday, who should I talk to in order to get it back?

pairs.text: sawwa2 bas tabarbour fat 3an maw2afi marrtein hal osbo3 w edtarreit a5od taxi
pairs.translation: I went to Tabarbour but missed my stop twice this week and had to take a taxi.

pairs.text: mukayyef bas sweileh 5arban min osbo3 wel taree2 bykoon shob ktir
pairs.translation: I'm just saying that Sweileh is 5 minutes away and the road will be very crowded.

pairs.text: dafe3 eshterak el bas lal fasel kamel bas esmi msh mawjood b kashf el sawwa2, fa kol yom el sob7 badtarr awarri el wasl
pairs.translation: I paid for the subscription for the whole semester but my name is not listed in the driver's list, so every morning I have to show the receipt.

pairs.text: bas el sa3a 4:30 tele3 2abel wa2to b 5ams da2aye2 kaman marra elyom, w kam wa7ad minna ra7 3aleh w estanaina el bas elli ba3do
pairs.translation: The bus at 4:30 left 5 minutes earlier today, and a few of us missed it and we waited for the next bus.

pairs.text: sawwa2 el bas bektob 3al mobile w sayeg b sur3a 3ala taree2 madaba hassa, wel tolab 5ayfin
pairs.translation: I just saw the bus writing on the mobile and driving quickly on the way to Madaba now, and the students are scared.

pairs.text: bas el masa nazzalna b maw2af 3'alat barra madaba el sa3a 9 bel leil w mashi, w ma fi mwasalat hon w e7na bentein la7alna
pairs.translation: We just got off at the bus stop outside Madaba at 9 PM and walked, and there are no transportation options here and we are two girls alone.

pairs.text: fi do5an tale3 min mu7arrek el bas w e7na mashyin w ri7et 7aree2, wel sawwa2 lessa ma wa2af
pairs.translation: There is smoke coming out from the bus engine and we are walking and the smell is like fire, and the driver hasn't stopped yet.

pairs.text: kif b2dar a7joz 3'orfet derasa jama3iyeh bel maktabeh la ejtima3at el mashroo3?
pairs.translation: How can I reserve a study room in the library for project meetings?

pairs.text: el sa3a elli fo2 bab el cafeteria wa2feh
pairs.translation: The hour above the cafeteria door is stopped.

pairs.text: la meen bballe3' 3an mushkleh siyaneh ba3d el dawam aw bel weekend?
pairs.translation: Who can help with a maintenance issue after work or on the weekend?

pairs.text: fi 5aza2en lal tolab bel jam3a? w kif ba5od wa7deh hal fasel?
pairs.translation: Are there scholarships for students at the university? And how do I get one this semester?

pairs.text: nos el afyash elli 3al 7eetan b mo5tabar el 7asoob msh sh3'aleh, fa ma bn2dar nesh7an el laptopat bel mu7adara
pairs.translation: The laptops in the computer lab are not working, so we can't charge the laptops during the lecture.

pairs.text: 7ammamat el tabe2 el thaleth ma fiha mai min el sob7, hassa bnesta5dem elli ta7t
pairs.translation: The third bathroom has no water since the morning, now we are using the one downstairs.

pairs.text: el asanseer b mabna el handaseh m3attal min yomein, wel tolab elli ma3hom 3'rad t2ileh byetla3o 3al daraj
pairs.translation: The elevators in the engineering building have been out of order for two days, and the students who have heavy bags have to go up the stairs.

pairs.text: fi kaza kursi maksoor b 2a3a 104, w kam taleb bedallo wa2fin wara bel mu7adara
pairs.translation: There are several broken chairs in 2A3A 104, and some students are standing behind in the lecture.

pairs.text: fi ri7et 3'az 2awiyeh b mo5tabar el kimya wel tolab saro ydo5o
pairs.translation: There is a very strong smell in the chemistry lab and the students started to feel it.

pairs.text: fi do5an w sharar tale3 min lo7et el kahraba b mamar el tabe2 el thani
pairs.translation: There is smoke and sparks coming from the electrical panel in the second floor corridor.

pairs.text: wa2a3at 2et3a min el sa2f b 2a3a B w e7na bel mu7adara, welli janbha shaklha mar5iyeh
pairs.translation: A piece of the ceiling fell down during the lecture, and the one next to it looks like it's going to fall too.

pairs.text: ba3d el 3asifeh wa2a3 3'osn shajara kbeer 3al mamsha janb el bawwabeh el ra2eesiyeh, w fi cable kahraba mtdalli janbo
pairs.translation: After the storm, a large tree branch fell on the walkway next to the main gate, and there is an electric cable hanging beside it.

pairs.text: kif byen7seb el m3addal el tarakumi? w lamma a3eed madeh el 3alameh el jdeedeh bt7ell ma7al el 2adimeh?
pairs.translation: How is the cumulative average calculated? And when I redo the new world material, does it replace the old one?

pairs.text: shu el shuroot 3ashan akoon m2ahhal lal sana el almaniyeh? el m3addal wel sa3at w mustawa el almani
pairs.translation: What are the requirements to be eligible for the German year? The average, the hours, and the German level?

pairs.text: fi 7esas ta2wiyeh aw musa3adeh la madet calculus 2 hal fasel?
pairs.translation: Is there any tutoring or help for the Calculus 2 material this semester?

pairs.text: 2adesh masmoo7 3'iyab bel madeh 2abel ma en7rem min el emte7an el niha2i?
pairs.translation: It's not allowed to be absent from the subject before we are banned from the final exam.

pairs.text: 3alamet el mid taba3ti b madet signals w systems msh tal3a, w kol el she3beh shayfin 3alamathom
pairs.translation: I marked my midterm in the Signals and Systems course, but it didn't come out, and everyone is seeing their grades.

pairs.text: jadwal el emte7anat el niha2iyeh 7atet emte7an fluid mechanics b 2a3a C-310, bas ma fi heik 2a3a b mabna C
pairs.translation: The schedule for the final exams has placed the fluid mechanics exam in room c-310, but there is no such room in building c.

pairs.text: ba3att el 5utta el derasiyeh lal murshed el akadimi min osbo3ein 3ashan ywafe2 3aleha w lessa ma radd
pairs.translation: I sent the study plan to the academic advisor two weeks ago so that he can approve it, and he still hasn't replied.

pairs.text: el doktor 7ateni 3'ayeb thalath mu7adarat ana kont 7aderha, w hassa sert 2areeb min el enthar
pairs.translation: The doctor gave me a grade of three for the lectures I attended, and now I have become close to failing.

pairs.text: en7ramt min el emte7an el niha2i bsabab el 3'iyab ma3 enni 2addamt 3uthr tibbi, wel emte7an ba3d 45 d2i2a
pairs.translation: I was banned from the final exam due to absence even though I submitted a medical excuse, and the exam is in 45 minutes.

pairs.text: ra7 3alay el final la2anni kont bel mustashfa, w talab el emte7an el ta3weedi lazem yewsal maktab el 3ameed 2abel el sa3a 2, wel murshed ma byrod
pairs.translation: I will miss the final because I was at the hospital, and the request for the remedial exam must reach the dean's office before 2 o'clock, and the advisor is not responding.

pairs.text: lazem asallem el resaleh la maktab el derasat el 3ulya 5elal sa3a, wel mushref lessa ma wa22a3 saf7et el mowaf2a
pairs.translation: I need to submit the application to the graduate studies office during the hour, and the supervisor still hasn't signed the approval form.
